label: Rematch — familiar boots
location: The Palisade Camp, the rebuilt feast ground

recentEvents.value: The Continuance brought him back to a feast ground being rebuilt; half the lantern poles are new.
The children recognize the sound of your boots now. They go quiet at the gate-bell before the adults do.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A recurring disaster with familiar boots; hospitality stopped being a survivable policy visits ago.

temporaryObjective.value: Ring every bell, empty the lanes, and say the true thing once: the children know his boots.

notes: REQUIRED (lore): the rematch carries 'The children recognize the sound of your boots now.' The Continuance restores memory, so he — and the children — remember every visit.
